description: Required core turn and contribution behavior. Except where a step says otherwise, messages are verified, authorized, structurally valid, and processed within a retained live context. These abstract conformance traces do not establish implementation conformance or restart durability. S denotes an opening say and therefore its turn identity; distinct letters denote distinct message identities. Unless a step states otherwise, conversation traffic uses an explicitly selected applicable continuity profile with valid authorized guards and retained required context at admission; stale traffic from an ended scope is rejected at that boundary before ordinary correlation or disposition handling.

cases.name: a fresh request opens one turn with one response contract

steps.event: no turn is open; fresh say S has no in_response_to and names operation summarize with valid initial input
expect: ack S
taken for S as new-turn with turn S
summarize establishes the turn response contract

steps.event: the actor completes the turn successfully
expect: one result naming S in in_response_to
result data satisfies the selected summarize output schema
S is closed

cases.name: multiple targeted contributions preserve the opening turn

steps.event: S is open under summarize; its guidance permits supplemental evidence and narrowing the requested scope
say C names S in in_response_to, omits operation, and supplies another source
expect: ack C
taken for C as added-to-turn with turn S
C inherits the summarize contract

steps.event: say D names S in in_response_to, repeats operation summarize, and requests a narrower scope
expect: ack D
taken for D as added-to-turn with turn S
no independent summarize invocation starts

steps.event: the actor completes S
expect: one result naming S
the response accounts for admitted C and D under the opening output contract
no separate terminal result is required for C or D

cases.name: an independent request does not silently join an open turn

steps.event: S is open; the actor can accept and classify messages
fresh say N has no in_response_to and names another known operation
expect: ack N
taken for N as not-acted-on without turn
no execution or implicit queuing of N
no busy solely because S is open
N does not change S's response contract

steps.event: S closes; an identical copy of N arrives
expect: normal duplicate acknowledgement
N is not reclassified as a new turn
a deliberate later invocation needs a new message identity

cases.name: completion before contribution does not create new work

steps.event: the requester sends contribution C naming S, but the transport delays C
the actor emits S's terminal result and later opens unrelated turn N
C arrives for the known closed turn S
expect: refusal closed for C
no reopening of S
no new turn for C
no addition of C to N

cases.name: an answer cannot reopen a closed question

steps.event: question Q belongs to S and has closed as answered, expired, or withdrawn
new say A names Q in in_response_to
expect: refusal closed for A
no reopening of Q
no automatic contribution to another question or turn

cases.name: an unknown target cannot establish its own turn

steps.event: C1 ended; properly established C2 has an active guard but no message S; the following contribution is newly signed for C2 rather than an original C1 frame
otherwise valid say C names S in in_response_to
expect: refusal unknown for C
no reconstruction of S or its operation from C
no new turn for C
no assertion that earlier work did not occur
an original frame signed for C1 would fail the C2 guard before unknown-reference handling

cases.name: only an opening say or a question is a contribution target

steps.event: S is open; C is an admitted contribution; P is a known progress message for S
new say D names C rather than the opening say S
expect: refusal malformed for D
no inferred retargeting to S

steps.event: new say E names P
expect: refusal malformed for E
no inferred retargeting to S

cases.name: a contribution cannot select another operation

steps.event: S is open under summarize; book is another known operation
say C names S in in_response_to and operation book
expect: refusal malformed for C
no book invocation
summarize remains S's response contract

steps.event: in a different conversation an unnamed turn U is open; say D targets U and introduces the known operation summarize
expect: refusal malformed for D
no implicit conversion of U into a named operation

cases.name: an unknown supplied operation remains unsupported

steps.event: S is open under summarize; operation absent_operation is not offered
say C targets S and supplies operation absent_operation
expect: refusal unsupported for C
no operation substitution
no contribution is admitted

cases.name: a turn contribution does not implicitly answer an open question

steps.event: S is open; question Q asks which source version to use; supplemental evidence is permitted
say C targets S and supplies additional evidence
expect: ack C
taken for C as added-to-turn with turn S
Q remains open

steps.event: say A targets Q and supplies a valid answer
expect: ack A
taken for A as answer with turn S and question Q
Q closes as answered
S retains its original identity and response contract

cases.name: a bounded operation may decline amendments

steps.event: S is a bounded request whose guidance permits no unsolicited amendments; its implementation may use a model or deterministic code
a valid say C targets S and proposes an amendment
expect: ack C
taken for C as not-acted-on without turn
no change to S's effective request
no independent invocation for C

cases.name: full replacement input requires permission and validation

steps.event: S's initial input requires document and region; its guidance permits targeted full-input replacement validated against that input schema
say C targets S with replacement data containing only region
expect: refusal malformed for C
no implicit merge with S's original data
S's effective input is unchanged

steps.event: new say D targets S with valid complete replacement data
expect: ack D
taken for D as added-to-turn with turn S
the permitted replacement changes the effective input
the opening output contract remains unchanged

cases.name: contribution data follows its declared meaning

steps.event: S's opening input requires document; its guidance separately defines contribution data as an object with exactly one string field constraint
say C targets S with data containing a valid constraint and no document
expect: ack C
taken for C as added-to-turn with turn S
C is validated as a contribution rather than as another opening input
the constraint is added without replacing S's document

steps.event: new say D targets S with numeric constraint
expect: refusal malformed for D
no admission of invalid contribution data

steps.event: another interaction has no declared interpretation for contribution data
expect: receipt of data alone supplies no implicit merge, replacement, or binding amendment of its opening input

cases.name: admitted correction precedes an obsolete completion

steps.event: S is being answered using figures V1
the actor admits C targeting S with corrected figures V2
expect: ack C
taken for C as added-to-turn with turn S

steps.event: an internal computation based only on V1 finishes
expect: no unqualified terminal success that silently ignores C
the actor accounts for C in the eventual response or explains why the amendment could not be applied
no prescribed model restart or internal scheduling mechanism

steps.event: the actor emits the terminal result for S
expect: one terminal result for S
later obsolete internal completions cannot produce another terminal outcome

cases.name: a later description cannot replace an open turn's output contract

steps.event: S opens under summarize, whose selected output requires total as a number
a later description advertises a different output for that operation name
a permitted contribution C is admitted to S
expect: the response contract selected for S remains unchanged

steps.event: the actor stops offering summarize for new requests; D targets S and repeats operation summarize
expect: ack D
taken for D as added-to-turn with turn S under its retained contribution rules
the retained operation is recognized before considering current operation availability

steps.event: S completes successfully
expect: result data satisfies S's selected output contract
the later advertisement does not retroactively redefine S's promised response

cases.name: an aggregate interaction has one defined composite outcome

steps.event: S opens an interaction whose contract permits accumulating inquiries and promises answers identified by their contributing message IDs
C and D target S with additional inquiries and are admitted
expect: taken for each as added-to-turn with turn S
the aggregate contract defines how the inquiries relate to the terminal result

steps.event: the actor completes S
expect: one result for S under the aggregate output contract
the response identifies how the admitted inquiries were addressed
no accidental combination of unrelated operation output schemas

cases.name: model runs and delegated results contribute to the parent outcome

steps.event: parent actor A has open turn S and consults actor B through separate turn U in B's conversation
B uses one or more internal model calls and returns result R for U
expect: R is B's addressed result under U's response contract
R closes U rather than S
A may incorporate R while S remains open

steps.event: A emits replaceable progress while synthesizing its response
expect: progress does not close S
provisional progress is not an independently completed typed deliverable

steps.event: A completes its own response
expect: A emits the terminal result for S under S's response contract
no one-to-one mapping between model calls and protocol turns is required

cases.name: opening-request suppression and duplicate handling precede new admission

steps.event: stop T with turn S has been accepted before opening request S; S has no in_response_to
S arrives and passes verification, authorization, and structural checks
expect: ack S
taken for S as not-acted-on without turn
no new work from the suppressed S

steps.event: an identical copy of S arrives later
expect: normal duplicate acknowledgement
no reclassification of S as a new turn
no additional execution
